text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: synth-prober-apac-east has 4 consecutive timeouts in the last 2 minutes -> PagerDuty incident #PD-6321 (https://pagerduty.example/PD-6321) :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Targets failing: apac-east prober group (canary sequence id: c-2026-03-15-11) response: timeout(10s)
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident PD-6321 assigned to maya_oncall. Trigger: threshold breach: 4/4 timeouts, rate 100%
maya: acked PD-6321 :white_check_mark: taking initial triage
maya: quick check — is this for all canaries in apac-east or just sequence c-2026-03-15-11?
ajay: looks like same sequence only, other sequences green on dash (apac-east cluster).
maya: ok re-running the prober job for that sequence now
ops-oncall: FYI seeing elevated 5xx from prober-ip 10.12.3.45 to endpoint synth-checker.internal: connection reset
samir: pinging infra, routing team to confirm anything regionally changed @infra-eng
infra-eng: we rolled a router update ~15m ago but it passed smoke tests. pulling router logs for apac-east now
maya: rerun output:
```
> curl -sv --max-time 8 https://synth-checker.internal/seq/c-2026-03-15-11
* TCP connection to synth-checker.internal port 443 failed: Connection reset by peer
* Closing connection 0
curl: (56) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer
```
ajay: same from my laptop repro. so not just prober infra.
ops-oncall: temporary mitigation idea: increase prober timeout to 15s and retry count to 2 so we don't immediately page on transient resets. want to avoid noisy pages during infra rollback checks.
maya: agree. Pushing prober config change to canary pool with short TTL: `kubectl -n prober set env deploy/canary-prober PROBE_TIMEOUT=15 PROBE_RETRIES=2`
infra-eng: holding off on rollbacks until we confirm cause, will watch router metrics for connection resets spike.
samir: timeline note: PD incident created +staging page. severity S2 for now — customer impact unknown, internal canaries only but could hide regressions.
pagerduty-bot: PD-6321: maya acknowledged (1st responder). escalation policy: next up samir in 7m if no resolution.
maya: deployed timeout bump to canary-prober in apac-east. Requeued canary sequence + manual rerun.
ops-oncall: logs after config change show some successful probes again, but intermittent resets persist ~1/10.
maya: good sign. continuing to monitor 5m. tagging customer-facing folks: @sales @support so they're aware in case of externally visible regressions.
ajay: found router logs with repeated `RST` to synth-checker backend from apac-egress node pool around 11:17-11:22 — looks like transient conntrack exhaustion on a subset of nodes.
infra-eng: confirmed. conntrack spikes correlated with a batch job that ran ~11:15; we throttled that job and are draining the impacted nodes.
samir: mitigation checklist: (1) increased prober timeout/retries (done), (2) throttle offending batch job (done), (3) drain & reprovision impacted nodes (in progress), (4) watch canary success rate -> aim <2% failures for 30m.
maya: will keep PD-6321 open and update on status. if success rate stabilizes we close in 30-60m.
ops-oncall: note — customers shouldn't be impacted yet; these are internal synth checks, but keep an eye on API 5xx alerting.
samir: creating follow-up operational postmortem ticket OP-1209 to track root cause + action items (conntrack defaults + batch job isolation). assigning to infra-eng and ops-oncall.
pagerduty-bot: PD-6321: incident status -> monitoring. next escalation in 5m if unresolved.
maya: handing off to samir for overnight watch — I'm on rotation change in 10m. samir please ack handoff.
samir: ack handoff. will monitor and reach out if anything blips back up.
ops-oncall: confirmed canary success rate at 11:48 is 98.4% (down from 0% during spike). no external incidents.
maya: thanks team, marking the thread for follow-up once postmortem ticket has initial timeline. :pray:
infra-eng: nodes drained, conntrack counters back to baseline. will propose kernel tuning + job gating in PR tomorrow.
samir: closing PD if stable for 45m. will post final status then.
pagerduty-bot: PD-6321: maya acknowledged -> samir now active (handoff).
incident-bot: Creating incident page: https://incidents.redwood/PD-6321 (S2)
ops-oncall: final note — keep the dynamic timeout change documented in runbook; revert after incident window ends.
samir: closing notes: root cause transient conntrack exhaustion caused conn resets to synth backend during batch job spike. mitigation: throttle batch, drain nodes, bump prober timeout temporarily, plan kernel tuning. follow-up OP-1209 created.
maya: thanks all. will add a quick blurb to #status-updates if anything customer visible appears.
